page.overview:
Who is Euenos?

Euenos who is sometimes called Lykormas is one of the Potamoi (the three-thousand river-gods who are sons of Okeanos and Tethys). In this case however, there is some controversy as towards who the true parents of Euenos is. The possible other father is Ares and other possible mothers are Demodike and Sterope
